description: Source code for a product search implementation using Frappe framework and Whoosh indexing, including schema definition, document indexing, search functionality, and index management functions.

classes.name: ProductSearch
classes.description: A wrapper class for full-text product search, extending FullTextSearch, providing schema, indexing, and search methods.

methods.name: get_schema
methods.description: Defines the search index schema with fields for title, name, path, content, and keywords.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the identifier field for documents, which is 'name'.

methods.name: get_items_to_index
methods.description: Retrieves all published items to be indexed, including static pages and document routes.

methods.name: get_document_to_index
methods.description: Creates a document dictionary for indexing from an item, extracting relevant fields and content.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query over the index with optional scope and limit, returning formatted results.

methods.name: parse_result
methods.description: Formats a search result into a dictionary with highlights and metadata.
